About the building

Designed for the way you live now.

Aria Residences pairs timeless architecture with thoughtful, human-scale interiors. Every floor plan was considered for light, flow, and flexibility — so each home feels distinct the moment you step inside. Explore any unit in full 3D before you ever book a tour.

  • Floor-to-ceiling glass with panoramic city views
  • Designer kitchens with integrated appliances
  • Smart-home climate, lighting, and security
  • Private balconies on every residence
Amenities

Everything you need, a few floors away.

Hotel-grade amenities designed for daily life — not just for show.

Rooftop pool

Heated infinity pool with skyline views, open year-round.

Fitness studio

Fully equipped gym with cardio, weights, and yoga room.

24/7 concierge

Front-desk service, package handling, and guest support.

Sky garden

Landscaped terrace with loungers and barbecue pits.

EV parking

Secure underground parking with EV charging on every level.

Smart building

Gigabit fiber, keyless entry, and a resident app.

Residents lounge

Curated lounge and dining room for private events.

Pet friendly

Pet spa and dog run — your companions are family.
